prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. Two crowds face each other across a wet cobbled street at night, red scarves on the left and blue scarves on the right, shown as black silhouettes against a burning barrel between them. Inside every silhouette, as a double exposure, is the same hidden scene: a basement where a printing press throws banknotes into the air and a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache dances, lit hot amber and red. Around the silhouettes the street stays real: rain on the cobbles, the barrel's flames smeared in vertical streaks on the wet stones, a gas lamp. Camera low behind the barrel. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
